claim.excerpt: During phase I metabolism, it is metabolized to (−)-11-hydroxy-Δ-9-tetrahydrocannabinol ((−)-11-OH-Δ-9-THC), which is psychoactive, and to (−)-11-nor-9-carboxy-Δ-9-tetrahydrocannabinol ((−)-Δ-9-THC-COOH), which is psychoinactive.

sources.title: Investigation of phase II metabolism of 11-hydroxy-Δ-9-tetrahydrocannabinol and metabolite verification by chemical synthesis of 11-hydroxy-Δ-9-tetrahydrocannabinol-glucuronide

why_it_matters: Metabolic pathway statements support interpretation of parent/metabolite findings.
